body.objective: Question: Beyond coding, what multi-agent systems run marketing, content production, sales or back-office automation in production? Cover architecture, human approval points, brand and quality control, and measured results, and say which are built on general agent platforms rather than bespoke code. Top-ranking pages should be primary sources (the organisation's own engineering blogs, docs, conference talks, papers, filings, open-source code) and credible reporting or case studies. Extract mechanisms (agent roles, orchestration, tools), human-in-the-loop approval steps, brand and quality guardrails, numbers, names, dates, measured results (time saved, conversion, cost, volume), failure modes, and whether each system uses a general agent platform (e.g. Salesforce Agentforce, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Google Agentspace, LangGraph, CrewAI) or bespoke code.
